1.

O come to the Lord Jesus, Fall down before His foot! For thee He has given Himself, For thee on the cross suffered.

C.

The message of grace resounds over the plain; Hear, O soul, for it kindly calls thee: Come to Jesus! Come to Jesus!

2.

Today Jesus will save From every sin and sorrow; He alone can help, He is our strong tower.

3.

For the whole wide world God’s arms stand open. He calls: Come all, Today grace is to be had!

4.

O love without bounds For every slave of sin! God so loved the world That He gave His Son.
